title: S4-DRAW-04 — A gradient stays in its selection.
goal: With a 12 x 10 Magic Wand selection, Pixel Gradient offers its shape, colour source, Bayer dithering and new-layer options; a click without a drag paints nothing, so the artwork, layers and history stay exact.

steps.why: By default a gradient goes on its own layer and leaves existing artwork untouched.
A click is not a gradient: nothing is painted and no layer is added.

cliOnly: a dragged gradient inside the selection with exact ramp colours and Undo (tests/production/selectionLimitsTools.spec.ts)
